I trust the Router's visual observation of 'soft edges' over the binary mask confidence here, as SAM may just be segmenting the combined mass.

I did not find new severe artifacts, but the cumulative effect of the minor ones (texture + edge softness + book fusion) suggests a generated image rather than a photograph.
